examName: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
note: Domain weights are approximate and based on Microsoft's publicly published skills-measured outline. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Plan, implement, and manage a solution for data analytics
subtopics: Plan a data analytics environment (capacities, SKUs, workspace planning)
Implement and manage a data analytics environment (workspaces, domains, OneLake)
Manage the analytics development lifecycle (Git integration, deployment pipelines, ALM)

domains.name: Prepare and serve data
subtopics: Design and implement loading of data (Dataflows Gen2, pipelines, notebooks)
Design and implement a data warehouse (Warehouse item, T-SQL, schemas)
Ingest and transform data with Lakehouses, shortcuts, and mirroring
Optimize performance of data storage and access (partitioning, V-Order, caching)

domains.name: Implement and manage semantic models
subtopics: Design and build semantic models (star schema, relationships, DAX measures)
Manage the semantic model lifecycle (XMLA endpoints, deployment, source control)
Optimize enterprise-scale semantic models (aggregations, incremental refresh, query performance)

domains.name: Explore and analyze data
subtopics: Perform exploratory analytics (notebooks, Spark, DAX queries)
Query data using SQL and KQL (Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence)
Visualize data (Power BI reports, Real-Time dashboards, paginated reports)
